product.name: Monofloral Honey
product.description: Pure raw honey sourced from a single flower type, available in over 200 varieties including Sidr, Manuka, Buckwheat, and Acacia.

product.name: Bulk Honey Supply
product.description: Wholesale supply of raw monofloral honey in large quantities, with minimum orders starting at 100 kg.

product.name: Beekeeping Essentials Bundle
product.description: A set of tools and protective gear including veil hat, hive tool, bee brush, and leather gloves for beekeepers.

product.name: Organic Sugar Products
product.description: Organic sugar derived from non-GMO sugarcane or sugar beets, minimally processed and free from synthetic chemicals.

product.name: Himalayan Salt Lamps
product.description: Handcrafted lamps made from Himalayan salt crystals that emit a warm amber glow for indoor ambiance.
